study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: growth velocities (GV) for estimated fetal weight (EFW)
gestational age at 3rd trimester growth scan
cohort: 630 women who underwent growth ultrasounds during the 3rd trimester
finding: Growth velocities for abdominal circumference and estimated fetal weight did not improve the prediction of large for gestational age infants when compared to using the third trimester Hadlock estimated fetal weight.
